description: Pedagogical example catalog for agents, docs, and smoke tests. Canonical examples teach typed Axiograph surfaces; debug export-era scripts are deliberately not the primary route.

examples.title: Minimal typed family ontology
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/Family.axi

examples.title: Family paths and HoTT-flavored witnesses
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/family/FamilyHoTT.axi

examples.title: Runtime theory graph and rewrite surface
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover theory-graph examples/ontology/OntologyRewrites.axi --out build/examples/ontology_rewrites_theory_graph.json

examples.title: Schema/category evolution and transport
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/ontology/SchemaEvolution.axi

examples.title: Supply-chain path semantics
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- cert query examples/manufacturing/SupplyChainHoTT.axi --lang axql 'select ?to where name("RawMetal_A") -Flow-> ?to limit 10' --out build/examples/supply_chain_query_cert.json

examples.title: Regulated production line with business and implementation surfaces
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-example-industrial --bin axiograph-industrial-example -- run-regulated-seed --axi examples/industrial/RegulatedProductionLine.axi --cache-root build/examples/industrial --run-id demo-001 --created-at-unix-secs 1713810000 --json

cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- discover behavior-case examples/industrial/RegulatedProductionLine.axi --request examples/behavior_cases/regulated_ship_release.json --out build/examples/regulated_ship_release_behavior_case_report.json

examples.title: Scientific ontology and measurement semantics
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/physics/PhysicsOntology.axi

examples.title: Proto/API semantics lowered to canonical ontology
commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p axiograph-cli -- check validate examples/proto/ProtoApiSemantics.axi
